8 Brazil highlights for under US$ 2:
• MASP in São Paulo: free on Tuesdays
• Avenida Paulista car-free on Sundays: free
• São Paulo metro: about US$ 1
• Elevador Lacerda in Salvador: US$ 0.20
• Sunset at Barra lighthouse: free
• Cachaça tastings in Paraty: usually free
• Bus to Trindade: about US$ 1
• Bus 120 to Iguazu Falls: under US$ 1
